subject: SIG: Clarify incident notification evidence handoff and timelines
messages:
From: Security Team <security@greenfintech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: dpo@greenfintech.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: incident notification windows and evidence handoff

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for starting the SIG intake last week. Our compliance reviewers ran into a couple of clarification items in section 7 (Incident Response / Breach Notification):

1) Notification windows: We need to confirm Redwood's definitions for initial notice vs. substantive notice (e.g., is initial acknowledgement within 24 hours or within 48 hours?). Please include the SLA for hosted API customers and any differences for Dedicated/Private deployments.

2) Point people and escalation path: We require a primary POC for 24/7 urgent notifications, a secondary, and a legal contact for breach notification letters. Can you provide names, emails, and role descriptions?

3) Evidence handoff: For incidents that require evidence (logs, request traces, export of affected KV caches), what's the expected delivery timeline once evidence is requested, and what formats do you provide? Also confirm whether evidence is delivered directly to the customer or via a secure redwood-managed bucket.

Would you be able to reply with these specifics and attach any templates or an evidence-handoff matrix you use? We are on a tight timeline for our SIG review (deadline 2027-06-25).

Thanks,
Leah Park
Security Reviewer
GreenFintech Inc.

---
Attachment: SIG-questionnaire-section7.pdf (page ref)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Security Team <security@greenfintech.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: incident notification windows and evidence handoff

Leah —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers up-front, and we can follow with the evidence templates attached. Below is our standard approach (we call this out in our IR playbook):

• Initial acknowledgement: <= 24 hours after we confirm a potential incident (email to customer POC).
• Substantive notice (high-confidence impact to customer data): <= 72 hours with summary + remediation status.
• SLA differences: Dedicated/Private customers can contract custom notice windows as part of the Dedicated SLA — default above applies to Hosted customers.

Point people (24/7 escalation roster):
• Primary: Marcus Lin — Incident Commander (marcus.lin@redwood.ai, +1 415-555-0142)
• Secondary: Irene Choi — Security Operations Lead (irene.choi@redwood.ai)
• Legal notifications: Stephanie Nguyen — Counsel, Privacy & Compliance (stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai)

Evidence handoff:
• Typical delivery: secure S3-compatible bucket shared for the request (pre-signed URL with 7-day expiry) or via an agreed SFTP for air-gapped customers.
• Standard formats: gzipped JSON logs, PCAPs (where applicable), request-trace CSVs, and a signed integrity manifest.
• Timeline: evidence staging within 72 hours for high-priority requests; full dataset delivery depends on scope (we estimate 3–7 business days for large exports).

Irene and Stephanie — can you review the timelines and confirm we can commit 72 hours for staging evidence and 3–7 business days for deliveries? Also attaching a lightweight evidence-handoff matrix and our SIG playbook excerpt.

Marcus
Incident Commander
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0142

---
Attachments: evidence-handoff-matrix.csv, SIG-incident-notify-playbook-excerpt.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, security@greenfintech.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: incident notification windows and evidence handoff

Marcus/Leah —

Confirmed from SRE and Data Ops: we can stage prioritized evidence bundles within 72 hours for incidents classified as "P1/P2". For very large datasets (multi-TB), staging may take longer; in those cases we will provide a progress cadence and initial samples within 72 hours.

A few practical notes for your SIG:
• We provide a manifest with checksums and a brief schema for logs to speed ingestion on your side.
• For hosted customers we typically use pre-signed S3 links; for Dedicated/Private we follow the customer's preferred transfer (SFTP, scp to a VPN-hosted endpoint).
• Access controls: evidence URLs are time-limited and tokenized; we additionally offer per-file encryption where required.

I've uploaded a short evidence-handoff matrix (CSV) and a sample manifest template to our shared drive link below. Marcus/Legal: happy to add the bucket naming pattern and retention window to the SIG if you want the explicit text.

Irene
Security Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
